Augmented reality · Experience design

An invitation that opens into an experience.

A printed wedding invitation connects guests to location, outfit guidance, occasion dates, and a gallery.

RoleInteractive invitation design
ScopePrinted invitation, AR content, guest information
ContextAR project

The starting point

Begin with a familiar object

The invitation concept uses a smartphone or tablet scan to bring additional wedding information into an interactive experience. The printed card is the entry point into a broader set of guest touchpoints.

Guest touchpoints

Put the useful details together

The proposed experience brings together location information, outfit guidance, occasion dates, and a photo gallery. These features address the practical questions guests may have before and during the celebration.

Location

Help guests understand the place

The location feature proposes map access and a three-dimensional view to help guests become familiar with the venue. It connects the invitation to the practical task of planning a visit.

Outcome

What the work brings together.

An AR invitation concept linking print to interactive guest information. The project illustrates the proposed features; the website presents the case study rather than running the original AR experience.
